writer.model: inherited native agent; API does not provide exact version

production_gate.publication_authority: Owner authorization is handled by parent; this draft grants no approval.

research_method: Institutional source pages were opened before drafting. Evidence and limits are author mapping, not an independent factual verdict. Two pages from one institution count as one institution.

episodes.title_en: Why Does a Breeze Dry Clothes Faster?
episodes.title_zh: 微風吹，衣服為何乾得比較快？
episodes.question: Why can moving air speed up drying?
episodes.description_en: A breeze carries water vapor away from wet fabric. Compare matching cloths while keeping temperature and humidity the same.
episodes.description_zh: 微風會帶走濕布旁的水蒸氣。固定溫度、濕度與布料，看看空氣流動如何加快乾燥。

sources.title: Evaporation Loss During Sprinkler Irrigation
sources.locator: Paragraph beginning 'Wind is an important factor', extracted lines 27–29.
sources.evidence: Wind transports water vapor away and replaces moist air near an evaporating surface.
sources.limits: Agricultural context; transfer principle applies to a wet surface, but its loss percentages are not used for clothes.

sources.title: Evaporation and Climate
sources.locator: Opening clothesline example and paragraph 'Wind speed', extracted lines 3–7.
sources.evidence: Wind carries water vapor away; dry, windy conditions increase evaporation.
sources.limits: Avoid the page's informal language that air 'holds' water and its oversimplified temperature-energy explanation.

sources.title: Humidity, Evaporation, and Boiling
sources.locator: Humidity and evaporation discussion, extracted lines 32–41.
sources.evidence: Evaporation occurs below boiling; water-vapor partial pressure affects net evaporation.
sources.limits: Molecular inset is symbolic; no humidity or drying-time prediction.

claims.text: Moving air can increase evaporation by carrying vapor away from a wet surface, replacing the moist air nearby.
limits: Compare equal initial water, fabric, exposed area, temperature and ambient humidity; do not promise faster drying in every weather condition.

claims.text: Liquid water can become water vapor below boiling; humidity influences the net rate.
limits: Vapor is individual molecules, not visible miniature liquid droplets. No air water-capacity container metaphor.

invariants: Two cloths begin with equal water content, material and exposed area. Same room temperature and ambient humidity; only nearby airflow differs.
At the same microscopic viewing scale, every water symbol has the same size in liquid and vapor. Track departures; no shrinking molecules.
Vapor markers remain distinct from broad airflow arrows. No steam cloud, boiling bubbles or visible droplet spray.
The contrast is qualitative and time-compressed, not a measured two-times drying rate.
episodes.simplification: An isothermal schematic of mass transfer. Real airflow can also change cloth temperature; that coupled effect and sunlight are excluded.

diagram_scale.cloth_panels: Two equal 300 by 380 px cloth rectangles at x=170 and x=610; no numerical fabric size asserted.
diagram_scale.molecular_inset: 12 equal-radius water markers initially on each matched patch; departures are tracked in the surrounding air region.
diagram_scale.time: Use 'Time compressed' during the wet-area comparison.

cues.en: Two equally wet shirts. Why can the one in a breeze dry faster?
cues.zh: 兩件一樣濕的衣服，為什麼吹到微風的那件可能乾得更快？
cues.visual: Illustrated clothesline; match shirts, then reveal a breeze beside the right shirt.

shot_plan.action: Illustrated clothesline; match shirts, then reveal a breeze beside the right shirt.
shot_plan.controls: Equal fabric, water and exposed area; breeze is the only comparison change.

cues.en: First, water can evaporate from wet cloth without ever reaching its boiling point.
cues.zh: 先看濕布：水不用沸騰，也能從布上蒸發。
cues.visual: Magnify one damp fiber patch into a separate symbolic molecular inset.

shot_plan.action: Magnify one damp fiber patch into a separate symbolic molecular inset.
shot_plan.controls: Keep actual shirt scene separate from inset; no bubbles or steam.

cues.en: Water molecules leave the surface and become invisible water vapor in the air.
cues.zh: 水分子離開表面，變成空氣中看不見的水蒸氣。
cues.visual: A few equal-sized water markers leave the wet patch; explain that visible markers are symbols.

shot_plan.action: A few equal-sized water markers leave the wet patch; explain that visible markers are symbols.
shot_plan.controls: Same marker radius across phases. No liquid-drop trail drawn as vapor.

cues.en: In still air, moisture builds up near the fabric, slowing further net evaporation.
cues.zh: 空氣不流動時，布旁的水蒸氣會增加，讓淨蒸發變慢。
cues.visual: Show vapor markers returning as well as leaving in the still-air panel.

shot_plan.action: Show vapor markers returning as well as leaving in the still-air panel.
shot_plan.controls: Some exchange continues; do not freeze all molecular motion or declare zero evaporation.

cues.en: A breeze carries that vapor away and brings less humid air alongside the cloth.
cues.zh: 微風把附近的水蒸氣帶走，讓較乾的空氣來到布旁。
cues.visual: Flow arrows carry vapor markers sideways out of the near-surface region.

shot_plan.action: Flow arrows carry vapor markers sideways out of the near-surface region.
shot_plan.controls: Ambient air is less humid than the moist boundary layer; do not change room humidity between panels.

cues.en: That lets more water escape overall, so the wet patch can shrink faster.
cues.zh: 整體離開的水就能更多，濕的部分也可能縮小得更快。
cues.visual: Resume equal-time cloth panels; reduce wet-area tint faster on the breezy side.

shot_plan.action: Resume equal-time cloth panels; reduce wet-area tint faster on the breezy side.
shot_plan.controls: Tint shows remaining wet area, not changing molecule size; qualitative rates only.

cues.en: Keep temperature, starting wetness, and fabric the same for a fair comparison.
cues.zh: 比較時，要固定溫度、起始含水量，以及布料。
cues.visual: Brief checklist connects both shirts with matching badges.
cues.overlay_en: Same temperature | Same fabric | Same water

shot_plan.action: Brief checklist connects both shirts with matching badges.
shot_plan.controls: No sun or heater appears on just one side.

cues.en: The breeze helps by removing nearby vapor. It does not make water disappear.
cues.zh: 微風的幫助，是帶走附近的水蒸氣；水並沒有消失。
cues.visual: Return to clothesline and follow a final vapor symbol beyond the shirt.

shot_plan.action: Return to clothesline and follow a final vapor symbol beyond the shirt.
shot_plan.controls: No vanishing molecule effect; markers leave the crop through a visible outflow.

episodes.title_en: What Holds a Suction Cup Down?
episodes.question: Why is a sealed suction cup hard to lift?
episodes.description_en: A suction cup seals a region of lower air pressure. The higher pressure outside helps keep it against a smooth surface.
episodes.description_zh: 吸盤封住一小塊氣壓較低的空間；外側較高的氣壓，幫忙把它壓在平滑表面上。

sources.title: Demos: 2A-01 Suction Cups
sources.evidence: A cup on a smooth surface resists removal; lifting the rim admits air. The pressure difference accounts for the holding force.
sources.limits: The complete-vacuum force estimate is an ideal upper bound and is deliberately excluded.

sources.title: Balloon and Cup Attraction
sources.locator: Explanation, extracted lines 23–27; tip around line 58.
sources.evidence: Expelling air and increasing the sealed volume reduces inside pressure; greater outside pressure holds the cup.
sources.limits: Balloon-and-cup demonstration differs from a rubber suction cup; only the pressure-difference mechanism is transferred.

claims.text: When a cup seals a region of lower air pressure, the greater outside pressure produces a net push toward the surface; admitting air reduces the difference.
limits: Use a flexible cup and a smooth nonporous horizontal surface. The cavity still contains air; no perfect vacuum or universal holding load.

invariants: Use the same cup on horizontal glass throughout, avoiding unspoken friction needed for a hanging vertical load.
Show some air remaining under the cup; never label the cavity a perfect vacuum.
Pressure acts from all directions; diagram selected opposing vertical contributions only, labelled 'Pressure forces: simplified'.
Lifting the edge creates an actual open route for air before the inside/outside labels equalize; the seal is not magnetic or glue.
episodes.simplification: Selected pressure forces and elastic cup recovery are shown qualitatively. Seal leakage and rubber stiffness affect real performance.

diagram_scale.cup: One 440 px wide cup on a horizontal glass strip y=1180; cross-section is a separate inset.
diagram_scale.pressure: Paired broad force arrows toward/away from glass with qualitative labels; no 1-atmosphere cavity assumption.
diagram_scale.release: Lift a 45 px rim segment; draw incoming air through that visible gap.

cues.en: This cup is hard to lift off smooth glass. What is holding it down?
cues.zh: 吸盤貼上平滑玻璃後，很難直接提起。是什麼把它壓住？
cues.visual: A hand gently tugs a cup straight upward from horizontal glass; it stays sealed.

shot_plan.action: A hand gently tugs a cup straight upward from horizontal glass; it stays sealed.
shot_plan.controls: No vertical wall or unsupported heavy object.

cues.en: Pressing the flexible cup flattens it and pushes some air out around the rim.
cues.zh: 壓下柔軟的吸盤，吸盤變扁，部分空氣從邊緣跑出去。
cues.visual: Cross-section flattens; a few air markers exit before the rim seals.

shot_plan.action: Cross-section flattens; a few air markers exit before the rim seals.
shot_plan.controls: Show outward path while rim is open; not all air removed.

cues.en: The rim seals against the glass as the cup tries to spring back.
cues.zh: 邊緣貼住玻璃形成密封，吸盤則試著恢復原來的形狀。
cues.visual: Rim contacts glass; dome recovers slightly with trapped air still visible.

shot_plan.action: Rim contacts glass; dome recovers slightly with trapped air still visible.
shot_plan.controls: Cup recovery increases cavity volume without lifting the sealed edge.

cues.en: The trapped air now has lower pressure than the air outside the cup.
cues.zh: 裡面剩下的空氣，氣壓就比吸盤外面低。
cues.visual: Reveal a lower-pressure label in the cavity and higher-pressure label outside.
cues.overlay_en: Inside: lower pressure | Outside: higher pressure

shot_plan.action: Reveal a lower-pressure label in the cavity and higher-pressure label outside.
shot_plan.controls: Residual particles remain inside; no 'vacuum' label.

cues.en: That pressure difference gives a net push toward the glass, helping hold the cup.
cues.zh: 這個氣壓差形成朝向玻璃的淨推力，幫忙把吸盤壓住。
cues.visual: Selected opposing pressure arrows combine into a downward net-arrow inset.

shot_plan.action: Selected opposing pressure arrows combine into a downward net-arrow inset.
shot_plan.controls: Arrows are schematic integrated pressure forces, not individual air jets.

cues.en: Now lift just one edge. Air can flow through the new opening underneath.
cues.zh: 只要掀起一個邊角，空氣就能從開口進入吸盤下面。
cues.visual: Lift the rim tab; inward markers pass through the new opening.

shot_plan.action: Lift the rim tab; inward markers pass through the new opening.
shot_plan.controls: Do not equalize before a visible opening exists.

cues.en: The pressures become more nearly equal, and the cup comes away much more easily.
cues.zh: 內外氣壓變得比較接近，吸盤就容易拿下來了。
cues.visual: Pressure labels converge, net arrow fades, then cup lifts clear.

shot_plan.action: Pressure labels converge, net arrow fades, then cup lifts clear.
shot_plan.controls: Release is continuous; do not depict a magic sudden disappearance of all air.

cues.en: A good seal preserves the pressure difference. Suction is a push from outside.
cues.zh: 好的密封能維持氣壓差；吸盤的作用，來自外面較大的推力。
cues.visual: Return to the intact cup and briefly replay the outside-pressure arrow.

shot_plan.action: Return to the intact cup and briefly replay the outside-pressure arrow.
shot_plan.controls: Qualify with higher outside pressure; no claim of an inward pulling vacuum force.

episodes.title_en: Why Does a Sliding Book Stop?
episodes.title_zh: 滑出去的書，為什麼會停下？
episodes.question: What slows a book sliding across a level table?
episodes.description_en: After your hand lets go, kinetic friction opposes the book's slide. Its motion energy is transferred mainly into thermal energy.
episodes.description_zh: 手放開後，動摩擦力阻礙書本滑動；書本的運動能量，主要轉成書本與桌面的熱能。

sources.title: Kinetic Friction
sources.locator: Kinetic friction section, extracted lines 144–170, especially sliding right / friction left example.
sources.evidence: Kinetic friction opposes relative sliding; an unpushed sliding object slows and stops.
sources.limits: The simple constant-coefficient model is approximate; static friction at rest need not be nonzero.

sources.title: Nonconservative Forces
sources.locator: Opening discussion and Example 7.9, extracted lines 23–25 and 67–81.
sources.evidence: Friction reduces mechanical energy; sliding-to-rest example relates work to lost kinetic energy and thermal energy.
sources.limits: No claim that total energy disappears or that all friction is dissipative.

sources.title: Physics 2211 Quiz 3 Solutions, Spring 2021
sources.locator: PDF page index 4 (printed page 5), question 5, extracted lines 219–238.
sources.evidence: For a book sliding on a table, the book-plus-table system gains thermal energy from kinetic friction.
sources.limits: Its worked example has a hand maintaining speed; use it for energy transfer only, not as the unforced deceleration demonstration.

claims.text: After the hand releases a book sliding on a horizontal table, kinetic friction opposes the slide and slows it.
limits: No continuing horizontal hand force. Air drag is neglected. Clamp motion at rest rather than reverse it.

claims.text: During the slide, mechanical energy is transferred mainly into thermal energy of the book and table.
limits: Some energy can also become sound and deformation. Temperature rise may be too small to feel; no glow or sparks.

invariants: Keep hand visibly clear after release; weight and table normal balance vertically.
Rightward velocity and leftward kinetic-friction arrows coexist during sliding; after rest, remove the kinetic-friction arrow and never reverse the book.
Total-energy accounting retains the initial energy; use thermal-energy increase in book plus table, not a disappearing energy bar.
Do not generalize to ideal rolling without slipping or say all static friction necessarily dissipates energy.
episodes.simplification: A level, stationary table with approximately constant kinetic friction; sound and deformation are minor unquantified channels.

diagram_scale.book: 240 by 95 px book sliding right across a 900 px table.
diagram_scale.optional_internal_model: If numeric motion is needed, m=1 kg, v0=2 m/s, mu_k=0.2, g=9.8 m/s^2; t_stop≈1.02 s and x_stop≈1.02 m. This is a model, not measured footage.
diagram_scale.motion: Scale 600 px/m for that optional model; slowed playback must say 'Slow motion'. Qualitative nonnumeric animation is also allowed.

cues.en: Give a book a shove. Once your hand lets go, why does it stop?
cues.zh: 推一下桌上的書。手放開後，它為什麼會停下來？
cues.visual: A hand pushes a book right, then lifts completely clear as the book slides.

shot_plan.action: A hand pushes a book right, then lifts completely clear as the book slides.
shot_plan.controls: Table is horizontal and stationary.

cues.en: The book is sliding across the table, and the two surfaces rub together.
cues.zh: 書本在桌面上滑動，兩個接觸的表面彼此摩擦。
cues.visual: Enlarge the contact region into a schematic rubbing-surface inset.

shot_plan.action: Enlarge the contact region into a schematic rubbing-surface inset.
shot_plan.controls: Do not present giant interlocking teeth as a literal universal microscopic mechanism.

cues.en: Kinetic friction acts opposite the slide: here, the book moves right, friction points left.
cues.zh: 動摩擦力的方向，和滑動相反：書往右滑，摩擦力就向左。
cues.visual: Blue velocity arrow points right; orange friction-force arrow points left.

shot_plan.action: Blue velocity arrow points right; orange friction-force arrow points left.
shot_plan.controls: Different colors and labels distinguish velocity from force.

cues.en: With no hand still pushing, that opposing force makes the book slow down.
cues.zh: 沒有手繼續推，這個反向的力就讓書本逐漸減速。
cues.visual: Equal-time position markers become closer together as the book slows.

shot_plan.action: Equal-time position markers become closer together as the book slows.
shot_plan.controls: Speed decreases continuously; no camera movement disguising speed.

cues.en: Its energy of motion has not vanished. Much becomes thermal energy in both surfaces.
cues.zh: 運動的能量沒有消失；大部分轉成書本和桌面的熱能。
cues.visual: Motion-energy bar falls while book-plus-table thermal-energy increment rises.

shot_plan.action: Motion-energy bar falls while book-plus-table thermal-energy increment rises.
shot_plan.controls: Bars balance within the stated simplified model; no new energy from nothing.

cues.en: The warming is usually too small to notice from one short slide.
cues.zh: 短短滑一次，溫度上升通常小到不容易察覺。
cues.visual: Small distributed thermal markers highlight both contact regions, with no visible glow.

shot_plan.action: Small distributed thermal markers highlight both contact regions, with no visible glow.
shot_plan.controls: No red-hot book, smoke, numerical temperature claim or claim of a measured experiment.

cues.en: When the book stops sliding, this kinetic-friction arrow stops too; it does not reverse.
cues.zh: 書本停止滑動後，這支動摩擦力箭頭也收起；書不會因此倒滑。
cues.visual: Book rests; velocity and kinetic-friction arrows fade to zero.

shot_plan.action: Book rests; velocity and kinetic-friction arrows fade to zero.
shot_plan.controls: No other horizontal force is present, so no static-friction arrow is needed.

cues.en: The missing motion became other energy. Friction changed the motion, not the energy total.
cues.zh: 少掉的運動，轉成其他能量。摩擦改變運動，總能量並沒有少掉。
cues.visual: Return to the resting book with the completed energy-transfer diagram.

shot_plan.action: Return to the resting book with the completed energy-transfer diagram.
shot_plan.controls: Conservation refers to the book-plus-table-plus-surroundings system, not the book's kinetic energy alone.

episodes.title_en: Why Do Bridges Have Expansion Gaps?
episodes.title_zh: 橋上的伸縮縫，有什麼用？
episodes.question: Why can a bridge need a gap between sections?
episodes.description_en: Bridge materials generally expand when they warm. An expansion joint leaves room for movement rather than forcing the deck to buckle.
episodes.description_zh: 橋梁材料受熱通常會膨脹。伸縮縫預留移動空間，減少橋面受限制時產生的熱應力。

sources.title: Thermal Expansion
sources.locator: Figure 1.5 expansion joints and linear thermal expansion section; extracted lines 34–49.
sources.evidence: Most materials expand when heated over ordinary ranges; bridge joints allow length changes without buckling.
sources.limits: Thermal expansion coefficients vary by material and temperature; not every material always expands.

sources.title: 770.7 Maintenance of Bridge Superstructure
sources.locator: Section 770.7.7 Expansion Joint Maintenance, extracted lines 96–100.
sources.evidence: Expansion joints accommodate bridge movement caused by temperature changes.
sources.limits: Real joints also accommodate other movements and have many designs; no engineering design prescription is given.

claims.text: Temperature changes make ordinary bridge materials change length; an expansion joint accommodates the resulting movement.
limits: Use an ordinary temperature range and one schematic span fixed at one end and free to move at the other. Not all bridges require the same visible joint.

invariants: Keep the pier positions fixed; show one deck end on a sliding bearing and the other end fixed, with a gap against the next fixed reference section.
Warmer deck becomes longer and the shown gap becomes narrower. Cooler deck becomes shorter and the gap widens.
The gap remains open in the normal illustration; do not teach that normal joints must slam shut in hot weather.
Thermal expansion displacement is exaggerated and labelled; no material identity, actual joint dimension or temperature-derived numerical promise is implied.
episodes.simplification: One-dimensional expansion of one span, ignoring temperature gradients, structural loads, creep and multi-span details.

diagram_scale.span: Deck from x=130 to x=740 when cool; adjacent fixed reference begins x=870. Draw fixed bearing left and sliding bearing right.
diagram_scale.comparison: Warm deck endpoint x=790, same adjacent reference x=870. 50 px movement is exaggerated, not a real bridge measurement.
diagram_scale.labels: Fixed end | Sliding bearing | Expansion gap | Movement exaggerated

cues.en: This gap in a bridge is deliberate. Why leave space in a solid road?
cues.zh: 橋面上的這道縫是刻意留下的。好好的路，為什麼要留空間？
cues.visual: Illustrated car passes over a covered bridge joint; reveal a simple side-view inset.

shot_plan.action: Illustrated car passes over a covered bridge joint; reveal a simple side-view inset.
shot_plan.controls: Road joint cover remains plausible; do not show a wheel-trapping hole.

cues.en: Most bridge materials expand when they warm up and contract when they cool down.
cues.zh: 多數橋梁材料變熱時會膨脹，變冷時則會收縮。
cues.visual: Side-view span changes from cool blue tint to warm orange tint.

shot_plan.action: Side-view span changes from cool blue tint to warm orange tint.
shot_plan.controls: Tint indicates temperature only, not melting or material transformation.

cues.en: Across a long span, even a small fractional change can mean noticeable movement.
cues.zh: 橋跨很長，即使只增加一小部分長度，也可能產生明顯位移。
cues.visual: Reveal a long span and enlarge its moving endpoint with a linked inset.

shot_plan.action: Reveal a long span and enlarge its moving endpoint with a linked inset.
shot_plan.controls: No invented numerical movement; magnification inset is explicitly separate.

cues.en: An expansion joint provides room for the bridge deck to change its length.
cues.zh: 伸縮縫就是預留空間，讓橋面能夠改變長度。
cues.visual: Label gap and sliding bearing; fixed piers remain still.

shot_plan.action: Label gap and sliding bearing; fixed piers remain still.
shot_plan.controls: One end fixed, one sliding; do not stretch fixed supports.

cues.en: In this simplified view, the warming deck lengthens and the gap becomes narrower.
cues.zh: 在這個簡化圖中，橋面變熱伸長，旁邊的縫就變窄。
cues.visual: Animate warm deck endpoint toward adjacent reference while gap shrinks.

shot_plan.action: Animate warm deck endpoint toward adjacent reference while gap shrinks.
shot_plan.controls: Left fixed end and adjacent reference do not move; never scale the whole image.

cues.en: As the deck cools and shortens, that same gap becomes wider again.
cues.zh: 橋面冷卻縮短時，同一道縫又會變寬。
cues.visual: Reverse the endpoint displacement and restore the cool view.

shot_plan.action: Reverse the endpoint displacement and restore the cool view.
shot_plan.controls: Changes use the same bridge and viewing scale.

cues.en: Blocking thermal movement can create large stresses, so engineers design ways to accommodate it.
cues.zh: 熱脹冷縮的移動若受到阻擋，就可能產生很大的應力，因此工程上要預留移動方式。
cues.visual: Briefly compare free movement with a restrained schematic carrying a stress label.

shot_plan.action: Briefly compare free movement with a restrained schematic carrying a stress label.
shot_plan.controls: No sensational bridge collapse; frame as design purpose, not a prediction for this bridge.

cues.en: The gap is useful space: it lets the bridge respond to changing temperature.
cues.zh: 這道縫是有用的空間，讓橋梁能隨溫度變化調整長度。
cues.visual: Return to the original bridge and highlight the joint unobtrusively.

shot_plan.action: Return to the original bridge and highlight the joint unobtrusively.
shot_plan.controls: Do not imply every bridge uses this exact joint or that temperature is the only load.

completion: 13-16 ready for independent review; 17-20 in progress
